scenes.tts: N G F keeps neurons alive. Does it also choose where their axons go?
scenes.caption: NGF keeps neurons alive. Does it also choose where their axons go?
scenes.visual: Title card: Permissive or Instructive. Sympathetic axons approaching a target tissue.
scenes.narration: NGF keeps neurons alive. Does it also choose where their axons go?

scenes.tts: A permissive signal allows an outcome that something else chooses. An instructive signal chooses the outcome itself.
scenes.visual: Two definition cards: permissive, allows what something else chooses; instructive, chooses.
scenes.narration: A permissive signal allows an outcome that something else chooses. An instructive signal chooses the outcome itself.

scenes.tts: Fuel lets a car go anywhere. The driver picks where. Fuel is permissive. The driver is instructive.
scenes.visual: A fuel can labelled permissive and a steering wheel labelled instructive.
scenes.narration: Fuel lets a car go anywhere. The driver picks where. Fuel is permissive. The driver is instructive.

scenes.tts: Removing a signal and restoring its normal pattern cannot tell the two apart. It only shows the signal is needed.
scenes.visual: A signal toggles off and back on in its normal place; both cards stay lit. Label: restoring the normal pattern cannot separate them.
scenes.narration: Removing a signal and restoring its normal pattern cannot tell the two apart. It only shows the signal is needed.

scenes.tts: Instead, keep the signal present, but change where or when it is delivered. Then ask whether the pattern still forms.
scenes.visual: The tile figure: a normal strip of eight tiles, four sage then four clay.
scenes.narration: Instead, keep the signal present, but change where or when it is delivered. Then ask whether the pattern still forms.

scenes.tts: If the pattern stays put, something else reads position, and the signal was permissive. If the pattern follows the delivery, it is instructive.
scenes.visual: The tile figure: even signal, pattern unchanged, permissive; moved signal, pattern follows, instructive.
scenes.narration: If the pattern stays put, something else reads position, and the signal was permissive. If the pattern follows the delivery, it is instructive.

scenes.tts: In nineteen eighty-nine, Edwards and colleagues directed N G F to the pancreatic islets of otherwise normal mice.
scenes.caption: In 1989, Edwards and colleagues directed NGF to the pancreatic islets of otherwise normal mice.
scenes.visual: Credit: Edwards and colleagues, 1989. A pancreas with scattered islets glowing with NGF.
scenes.narration: In 1989, Edwards and colleagues directed NGF to the pancreatic islets of otherwise normal mice.

scenes.tts: Islets are small clusters of hormone-making cells scattered through the pancreas.
scenes.visual: Zoom into one islet: a small cluster of cells within pancreatic tissue.
scenes.narration: Islets are small clusters of hormone-making cells scattered through the pancreas.

scenes.tts: Predict. Where do the sympathetic fibres go?
scenes.visual: Question card over the pancreas: where do the fibres go?
scenes.narration: Predict. Where do the sympathetic fibres go?

scenes.tts: Innervation of the islets rose sharply. The surrounding tissue gained no matching rise. The pattern followed the delivery.
scenes.visual: Surrounding exocrine tissue keeps its sparse baseline fibres; the NGF-making islets fill densely with sympathetic fibres. Label: instructive.
scenes.narration: Innervation of the islets rose sharply. The surrounding tissue gained no matching rise. The pattern followed the delivery.

scenes.tts: In nineteen ninety-three, Hoyle and colleagues ran the converse test. Their mice had sympathetic neurons that made N G F themselves.
scenes.caption: In 1993, Hoyle and colleagues ran the converse test. Their mice had sympathetic neurons that made NGF themselves.
scenes.visual: Credit: Hoyle and colleagues, 1993. Sympathetic neurons that glow with their own NGF.
scenes.narration: In 1993, Hoyle and colleagues ran the converse test. Their mice had sympathetic neurons that made NGF themselves.

scenes.tts: Now N G F was made by the neurons too, not only by the target.
scenes.caption: Now NGF was made by the neurons too, not only by the target.
scenes.visual: Extra NGF sources glow on the neurons and along their axons; the target's own sources remain. Label: altered distribution, not shown to be uniform.
scenes.narration: Now NGF was made by the neurons too, not only by the target.

scenes.tts: Axons still reached their tissues. But inside them, they branched sparsely.
scenes.visual: Axons arrive at a target tissue and branch only a little inside it.
scenes.narration: Axons still reached their tissues. But inside them, they branched sparsely.

scenes.tts: Making N G F in the islets of these mice restored islet innervation.
scenes.caption: Making NGF in the islets of these mice restored islet innervation.
scenes.visual: In the same mice, islets that make NGF fill with fibres again.
scenes.narration: Making NGF in the islets of these mice restored islet innervation.

scenes.tts: So, in the sympathetic targets tested, N G F is permissive for reaching a target.
scenes.caption: So, in the sympathetic targets tested, NGF is permissive for reaching a target.
scenes.visual: Summary card, line 1: reaching a target, permissive (sympathetic targets tested).
scenes.narration: So, in the sympathetic targets tested, NGF is permissive for reaching a target.

scenes.tts: It is instructive for how densely, and where, axons innervate within it. Here the fuel analogy breaks.
scenes.visual: Summary card, line 2: density and place within a target, instructive. The fuel can gains a small steering wheel.
scenes.narration: It is instructive for how densely, and where, axons innervate within it. Here the fuel analogy breaks.

scenes.tts: One more test. In mice lacking both N G F and Bax, sympathetic neurons survive.
scenes.caption: One more test. In mice lacking both NGF and Bax, sympathetic neurons survive.
scenes.visual: The evidence table adds a row: NGF and Bax both deleted, neurons alive.
scenes.narration: One more test. In mice lacking both NGF and Bax, sympathetic neurons survive.

scenes.tts: With death blocked, any defect left is not about survival. They fail to innervate many of their targets.
scenes.caption: With death blocked, any defect left is not about survival. They fail to innervate many of their targets.
scenes.visual: Many targets stay bare. Label: needed for more than survival.
scenes.narration: With death blocked, any defect left is not about survival. They fail to innervate many of their targets.

scenes.tts: Put the lesson together. The target is needed. Adding N G F saves neurons. Removing it, by antibody or by gene, kills them.
scenes.caption: Put the lesson together. The target is needed. Adding NGF saves neurons. Removing it, by antibody or by gene, kills them.
scenes.visual: The checklist from chapter two: four items ticked; item 5, timing, marked: needs paired counts of axon arrival and death.
scenes.narration: Put the lesson together. The target is needed. Adding NGF saves neurons. Removing it, by antibody or by gene, kills them.

scenes.tts: The track A mutant shows the neurons were made, then lost. Acting as a survival factor, N G F cannot raise survivors above the number made.
scenes.caption: The TrkA mutant shows the neurons were made, then lost. Acting as a survival factor, NGF cannot raise survivors above the number made.
scenes.visual: The time-course plot and the ceiling plot side by side.
scenes.narration: The TrkA mutant shows the neurons were made, then lost. Acting as a survival factor, NGF cannot raise survivors above the number made.

scenes.tts: N G F keeps already specified neurons alive, and types differ in that need. Where it is supplied helps decide which connections stay.
scenes.caption: NGF keeps already specified neurons alive, and types differ in that need. Where it is supplied helps decide which connections stay.
scenes.visual: Closing card: the guiding idea, then: for survival, NGF keeps specified neurons alive; where it is supplied helps decide which connections persist.
scenes.narration: NGF keeps already specified neurons alive, and types differ in that need. Where it is supplied helps decide which connections stay.

scenes.tts: How some neurons come to win is the subject of the lesson on competition for targets.
scenes.visual: Next-lesson card: competition for targets.
scenes.narration: How some neurons come to win is the subject of the lesson on competition for targets.

scenes.tts: Takeaway: for survival, N G F is permissive. Within a target, it also instructs where axons branch.
scenes.caption: Takeaway: for survival, NGF is permissive. Within a target, it also instructs where axons branch.
scenes.visual: Final card: permissive for survival; instructive for branching within a target.
scenes.narration: Takeaway: for survival, NGF is permissive. Within a target, it also instructs where axons branch.
